rounds.text: Capital Infra Trust is trading at an exceptionally attractive valuation with a price-to-earnings ratio of just 6.67x and a price-to-book multiple of 1.08x [E1, E2]. Fundamental performance is experiencing a massive inflection point, highlighted by a compounded sales growth of 421% and compounded profit growth of 653% over the trailing twelve months [E8, E9]. Operational turnaround is striking as quarterly operating margin surged to 56% in June 2026—a monumental 99 percentage point expansion over the year-ago quarter [E12]. Cash generation is extraordinarily robust, delivering Rs 1,025 Cr in operating and free cash flow for March 2026, which fully backs reported profits at a 4.86x cash conversion rate [E15, E16, E17]. Furthermore, the discount to intrinsic value is massive, featuring a 70.7% margin of safety where the current price implies an overly pessimistic -7.4% earnings growth rate [E23, E24, E25]. Conceded: ROCE and ROE are low at 7.2%, borrowings increased to Rs 2,961 Cr, and the yearly operating margin trend is inconsistent [E6, E7, E13, E20].

Capital Infra Trust is trading at an exceptionally attractive valuation with a price-to-earnings ratio of just 6.67x [E1] and a price-to-book ratio of 1.08x [E2]. The company exhibits explosive top and bottom-line expansion, boasting compounded sales growth of 421% and compounded profit growth of 653% over the trailing twelve months [E8, E9]. This operational acceleration is backed by stellar cash generation, featuring an operating cash flow of Rs 1,025 Cr in Mar 2026 which covers reported profit by 4.86 times [E15, E16]. Furthermore, a discounted cash flow valuation points to an intrinsic value of Rs 259 per share against the market price of Rs 75.9, providing a substantial margin of safety of 70.7% [E23, E24]. The reverse DCF indicates that the current market price incorrectly prices in a negative earnings growth of -7.4%, starkly contrasting with the company's surging results and improving debtor days from 41.5 to 17.5 days [E25, E30]. conceded: [E6].
